text:
Priya (AE): AcmeSec asked if we can run a 10-day POC where logs stream to their security account and devs get short-lived API tokens. They want minimal exposure of prompt text and SOC2 artifacts. Can we scope this?

Sam (Sales Eng): yes. Two approaches: 1) Hosted + log export only (lower compute cost) or 2) Dedicated pool inside a peered VPC (better isolation). Both can deliver audit exports to a customer-owned S3/GCS topic.

Grace (Client-Sec): must call out: no raw prompt bodies to S3. We'll accept hashed payloads + metadata (request_id, model, timestamp, client_ip). Also need log integrity (object metadata + checksum) and proof of delivery.

Tessa (Security): for SOC2 evidence they'll want: sample audit files (masked), proof of TLS+SSE-KMS, list of RBAC roles used in the POC, and key rotation policy. Also request an in-scope data map for the POC.

Rafael (Infra): infra ask list for customer:
- S3 bucket ARN + region
- KMS CMK ARN (if they want to manage keys)
- IAM principal or account number for cross-account role
- Allowed prefix for objects (e.g., acme/poc-audit/)
- CIDR for VPC peering (if Dedicated)

Rafael (Infra): sample minimal bucket policy below (they can restrict by prefix + principal):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowRedwoodPut",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::REDCLOUDACCOUNT:role/redwood-audit-writer"},
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::acme-poc-logs/acme/poc-audit/*"
    }
  ]
}
```
We can provide the exact principal once the ticket is open.

Sam (Sales Eng): on ephemeral tokens: recommended flow is OIDC-backed short tokens or our token-exchange with TTL. Example OIDC-like exchange (pseudo):
```bash
# exchange service token for ephemeral scoped key
curl -X POST https://token.redwood.example/v1/exchange \\
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <svc-pri-secret>' \\
  -d '{"aud":"acme-poc","scope":"inference:invoke","ttl":7200}'
```
Returned key is bounded to scope and expiry. We record issuance in audit stream.

Grace (Client-Sec): can we also include client_ip in logs? need to tie calls to origin IPs for forensic use.

Tessa (Security): yes — we emit client_ip in metadata but call out privacy: if they require anonymization for some users, that must be specified up front.

Priya (AE): pricing Q 10-day Dedicated POC with 2 small GPUs + logs export costs?

Sam (Sales Eng): rough: compute commit $Y/day for dedicated slice, plus storage/egress. We'll send a formal quote. Option to run compute in hosted mode and just stream logs out to reduce compute cost by ~40%.

deploybot: checklist: 1) NDA signed 2) bucket ARN + kms arn 3) customer account for cross-account role 4) CIDR for peering (if needed) 5) list of devs for scoped tokens 6) retention period (365 days) 7) PII classification for prompts

Priya (AE): OK I'll get NDA on file and ask AcmeSec for bucket + kms + CIDR. Rafael please open infra ticket for cross-account role and temp pool. Tag Tessa for SOC2 artifacts.

Rafael (Infra): will do. scheduling a 30-min kickoff tomorrow. I'll attach a short threat-model template for them to fill (what data goes to model).

Grace (Client-Sec): thanks all. We'll provide a short doc listing what we consider PII and whether any redaction is required.

Sam (Sales Eng): added note: if they want prompts masked but still searchable, we can emit salted hashes per request_id so they can correlate without storing text.

Priya (AE): great, sending recap to AcmeSec after this thread.
